name: M7.Connectivity.gcd_mem
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (H : AddSubgroup (ZMod N)) (S : Finset ℕ), (∀ a ∈ S, (a : ZMod N) ∈ H) → ((S.gcd id : ℕ) : ZMod N) ∈ H
guidance: Finset induction, gcd_empty=0 and gcd_insert. For insert use Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab (integer Bezout), cast to ZMod N and H.zsmul_mem on the two previous members, then add_mem. Preserve empty S, no coprimality assumed. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.
